scope: R0 / Cell / P1–P4 / P5 / original UI frozen summaries, necessary indexes and direct OWNERS evidence; excludes later root Operations/P0/test/CI work.

format_policy.large_binaries: URL and original SHA256 only; never copy archive/tool/cache/worktree
format_policy.r0_projection: One complete 1623-row semantic identity index; not the full raw metadata and not a chunk series.

r0.qualification: Live API URLs establish origin, not an immutable byte archive of the omitted metadata snapshot.

cell.qualification: Exact source blobs are immutable references; PR/check metadata is frozen only where included.

p1_p4.qualification: Source bindings and original whole logs carry exact identities; omitted retrieval wrappers are not claimed as byte-archived.

p5.qualification: Large combined snapshot omitted. Exact owner identities remain in OWNERS; API provenance is not an immutable archive of the original response wrapper.

ui.qualification: No browser executable, dependency installation, tool cache or binary artifact is copied. Diagnostic result is not product qualification.

owners.qualification: No later Operations/P0/test/CI result is added by this package.

provenance.statement: Non-lossless summary, not a chunk or replacement for the complete raw metadata snapshot.

provenance.reason: Frozen FINDINGS identifies it as unrelated initial diagnostic; stable original artifact ID/URL not retained. Not used as product-failure evidence.
